propositions: Operators force-close ~25 administrative-disposition tickets (duplicate, obsolete, wontfix, superseded) weekly because the completion verifier cannot pass them and no truthful exit is discoverable.

The close-class vocabulary is incomplete and inconsistently scoped: bug-only classes (not_a_bug, escalated) exist; administrative classes (obsolete, wontfix, superseded) do not; non-bug tickets have no valid close path.
The --reason flag rejects non-force closes, blocking operators from recording justifications for reason-required administrative dispositions even when a completion gate is disabled.
Close-precheck failure messages do not enumerate applicable --class values or hint the administrative disposition alternative, leaving operators without guidance on the truthful exit.

Administrative closes must skip completion verification (AC/file-impact/billable checks) and route through a disposition verdict signed with class+reason attestation, distinct from force-close channels.
